title: 店舗用巻き上げシャッター
description: 41枚の成形スラット、開口した側面ガイド、頭上ボックス、引手と下端シールを備えた静的シャッター。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A static shopfront shutter with 41 formed slats, open side guide channels, folded headbox, pull handles and bottom weather seal. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
